_note: Every value is extracted from a claim quote by compute.py, or computed here from values that were.

proteins_release.basis: about this many proteins exist within mitochondria, the release

proteins_curated.basis: the curated list the screen ran on

likely.basis: likely interactions catalogued, mean ipTM over the cutoff

proteins_involved.basis: proteins with at least one likely partner

proteins_without.basis: curated proteins with no likely partner, computed

share_pct.basis: likely as a percent of pairs, two decimals half up, equals the paper's 0.46%

one_in.basis: pairs per likely interaction, nearest whole pair

recall_pct.basis: recall at the cutoff on the authors' test set

fdr_pct.basis: false discovery rate at the cutoff, about

tp_at90_pct.basis: share of true positives recovered at 90% precision, approximate

new_pct.basis: share of predictions in no existing database

orphans.basis: uncharacterized proteins given at least one predicted partner

disease_pct.basis: nearly this percent of mitochondrial proteins carry disease-linked mutations

leg_cells.basis: cells along each leg of the half matrix, one protein against each other one

tile_side_cells.basis: side of a square tile whose area is every likely pair, drawing only

block_cols.basis: columns of the brass block, drawing only

block_full_rows.basis: full rows of the brass block, drawing only

block_last_row.basis: cells in the block's last row, drawing only

new_cells.basis: cells of the block drawn as new, from the rounded share, drawing only and never printed

boss_total.basis: the hundred calls drawn above the step, a drawing unit

boss_brass.basis: calls of a hundred drawn in brass, by the stated precision

boss_steel.basis: calls of a hundred drawn in steel, equal to the stated false discovery rate
